plan.text:
Complete Sprint 4 remaining items for the Execution Mode system:

1. Multi-session lock file: Prevent two sessions from entering execution mode in the same project simultaneously. Add lock file logic to the extension (write {project}/.pi/execution-mode.lock with PID, check on register_plan).

2. Proactive compaction: Monitor context usage in the extension's turn_end handler. When usage exceeds a threshold (e.g., 80% of context window), trigger compaction before the next agent turn to prevent overflow.

3. Deadline escalation: Add escalation logic to the extension's before_agent_start hook. When deadline is approaching/passed, inject increasingly urgent language and adjust safety counters (e.g., allow more continuations when deadline is near).

phases.name: Multi-session lock file in execution-mode extension
Test and commit all Sprint 4 changes
